## Requirements (contract § In scope)

1. **Job classes and SAs (G1-01).** Every live job assigned to a class
   and SA: `sig-ingest-rt` (`cloudsql.client`; `objectCreator` +
   `objectViewer` on the restricted bucket, **no `objects.delete`** —
   the conditioned `objectUser` covers only the captures prefix),
   `sig-export-rt` and `sig-materialize-rt` (their buckets +
   `cloudsql.client`), `sig-probe-rt` (read-only posture), plus the
   reserved identities `sig-quality-probe-rt` (P34.44b), `sig-release-rt`
   (P35.53), `sig-status-rt` (P36.43) and `sig-scheduler` — created
   with no runtime grants until their rows land, so the declaration
   never claims a grant that is not in force.
2. **Overwrite check before removing delete (SIG-STORE-048).** The
   ingest write path DOES replace one object: `OcflStore.add_version`
   rewrites the OCFL inventory head in place on re-capture. Honest
   resolution, never a bucket-wide delete grant: a prefix-scoped IAM
   condition `p34-42b-capture-rewrite` scopes `roles/storage.objectUser`
   to `objects/evidence/captures/` — recorded in **ADR-201** and the
   standing-review row `D-P34.42b-1` for P37.3.
3. **Jobs on their SAs.** Each of the 88 jobs updated with
   `--service-account` (no image change — a same-image gate reads the
   digest before and after); deploy paths (`scheduled-ops.sh`,
   `export.sh`, `materialize.sh`, `sig-ops job-roll`) pass
   `--service-account` explicitly; the 79 scheduled triggers invoke
   with `sig-scheduler` holding `run.invoker` on their jobs only;
   `sig-alerts`' invoker moves `default-compute` → `sig-probe-rt`.
4. **Remove `roles/editor`.** Only after a read shows no workload
   still runs as the default compute SA does the `editor` step remove
   `roles/editor` — declared `[[remove_role]]`, applied LAST.
5. **Probes.** Read-only IAM analysis (`sig-ops iam diff --leg jobs`
   + policy-troubleshooter incl. the off-prefix delete probe — a
   GRANTED answer hard-fails); the next scheduled fire of one job per
   class is read back by the leg (AR-4) for P34.39b's table.

**MET-DIFFERENTLY / deviations:** (a) the 4,007-line size overage
(above) — the P34.42a precedent of recording, not splitting mid-run;
(b) the contract's deliverable-1 wording grants `sig-probe-rt` a
"read-only" posture — the declaration gives it `cloudsql.client` +
`secretAccessor` on its own keys + `run.invoker` on `sig-alerts` (the
least privilege its actual job — polling services and writing probe
results — requires; a strictly read-only SA could not write its own
capture). (c) `jobs_revoke` is new declaration vocabulary: under
`--leg services` the compute SA remains a desired consumer (jobs still
run as it); under `--leg jobs`/`all` it is desired-absent — the two-leg
shape keeps `iam diff` honest at every leg boundary.
